title: Non-Emergency Permanent Congregate Housing Services
agency: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
agency_path: City of New York > Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
submit_to: 375 Pearl Street, 25th Floor, New York, NY 10038
description_text:
The New York City Human Resources Administration (HRA) through its HIV/AIDS Services Administration (HASA) intends to renew one (1) contract with Services for the Underserved Inc for the provision of non-emergency permanent congregate housing. The renewal term of the contract will be from 6/1/2027 to 5/31/2032.

Anyone having comments on the performance of the contractors, or the proposed renewal of the contracts may contact Jacqueline Dudley.

This notice is for informational purposes only.
